events.title: Abjure v0.5 alpha - Patch Notes
events.summary: This update gives every relic build a full ladder: a consistency common, a payoff that only works for you, a capstone, and a boss built to counter it. It also adds a sixth character, a free choice at the start of every run, and a reworked Settings screen.NEW CHARACTER- The Duelist: Riposte. Answer the opponent's single, pair or triple with the same number of cards of the very next rank up (a 7 on a 6, a pair of 2s on a pair of Aces) and your lowest card also leaves your hand. events.title: Abjure v0.4 alpha: 16 new relics, 5 new bosses, and relic builds
events.summary: v0.4 alpha is out, and it's a big one: 16 new relics, 5 new boss modifiers, 5 new crossroads events, a new gambit, a new hand type and 16 new achievements. Everything new is translated into all 19 languages.Relic buildsRelics now belong to builds: Flush, Sets, Straight, Tempo and Control, plus Economy. events.title: Abjure v0.3 alpha — The Reckoning Update
events.summary: This is the biggest update Abjure has had. Beating the game is no longer the end of a run, every level has a new kind of event round, there is a daily run shared by every player, the whole game now plays in 19 languages, and every screen can be driven from a keyboard or a controller. Both the full game and the demo are updated.In short:The Reckoning — press on past the final boss into rounds 25–32 for score.Crossroads — one optional, non-fight event per level with a real decision in it.Daily Cha

events.summary: TutorialA tutorial is added. The tutorial will be suggested when you start the game for the first time, and you can replay the tutorial by clicking "How to Play" on main menu and then clicking the green "Interactive Tutorial" button near the top of the "How to Play" screen.19 New LanguagesThe game can now be played in:English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, German, French, Indonesian, Italia
